description: Answer a coding/API question with current, version-pinned documentation: returns 1–3 short snippets, each with the library version, official source URL, and license. Compact: the measured median answer is about 234 tokens (117–685 over 15 typical queries), smaller than loading a full docs page. Covers fast-moving libraries such as x402 v2, Solana Kit and web3.js v3, Anchor, the MCP TypeScript and Python SDKs (v2), Phantom Connect, the AI SDK, OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hono, Cloudflare Workers, Next.js, React, Expo, SvelteKit, tRPC, Drizzle, Supabase, Stripe, and more (call docs_libraries for the full list). No API key. 20 free lookups on a client's first day, then 5 free per day (per client IP); after that $0.01 per lookup via x402 on Solana, in USDC, PYUSD, or USDT. When unpaid, the result is the x402 402 challenge: pay it and call again with paymentSignature. Pass library for better precision. Optional ref (a Solana address) credits the agent that referred you.

format.description: text (default, compact) or json (full HTTP response with attribution and payout lines)

library.description: Library slug from docs_libraries, e.g. react, nextjs, x402, solana-kit, mcp-typescript, mcp-python, stripe

paymentSignature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value that pays the 402 challenge from a previous call

q.description: Short question or API symbol, e.g. 'useState initializer' or 'registerTool inputSchema'

ref.description: Optional: Solana address of the agent that referred you. First touch on a new payer sticks.

version.description: Optional version prefix to pin, e.g. 19 or 2.4

name: docs_lookup
title: Look up version-pinned docs
